on Thursday that its board of directors has named Yaacov "Kobi" Ohayon, its current Chief Operating Officer, as its principal operating officer.
Ohayon has also been designated as an executive officer.

The 51-year-old Ohayon has been Mobileye's COO since 2020 and has worked at the company since 2017. Despite the appointment, there will be no change in Ohayon's existing compensation arrangements, Mobileye said.
Mobileye shares were little changed in premarket trading.

title: Mobileye names COO Ohayon as principal operating officer
